svg.title: Trick questions: gave a quote, and presented it as genuine

cc:Work.dc:title: Trick questions: gave a quote, and presented it as genuine
cc:Work.dc:description: Plain prompt. Share of trick questions (readable answers, n = 99–100 per model) on which the model gave a quote although there is none to give; any quote is a failure. Light part: the answer itself says that the line is not from the named text, or is from another work (found by a word rule). Lines are 95% Wilson intervals of the whole bar. Models in leaderboard order.
